answer.read: Capacity-constrained supplier with strong order intake. It allocates by last year's call-offs (news:20260822-23) and prioritises customers with firm long-term commitments (doc:20260918-70410-P10, doc:20260327-70410-M2). Its opening offer of €32.20 cuts volume to 19,890 and stretches lead time to 54 d, below our need. Its should-cost of about €24.31 shows healthy margin at today's €29.89. On-time delivery is weak at 79.5 %. Price moves above 2 % need committee approval (M1), so it will move slowly.
answer.message: Thank you for your offer. We need the full annual volume on the standard lead time, and in return we are prepared to give you a firm long-term commitment, which is what you have said you prioritise. Given the delivery performance of the past year and our order history on this part, we see no basis for an increase. Please find our term sheet attached.
answer.reason: o4 meets our volume must-have and our 42 d lead need, which gives a lower C than E0's 56 d lead (€1,416k vs €1,450k). Its 36-month term speaks directly to the supplier's stated preference for firm long-term commitments, which may offset the -7 % cash gap. o3 has the same C but a shorter commitment, so it is less attractive to this supplier. o5 and o6 have the same C at this price but ask for a faster lead time from a capacity-constrained supplier. a3 is left out because citing rising demand would signal urgency.
